channel.title: Book Summaries: History and Archaeology
channel.description: Discover comprehensive book summaries covering self-help, business, psychology, relationships, productivity, and classic novels. Get key insights and takeaways from bestselling books in minutes.

item.title: 1491 by Charles C. Mann
item.description: How Indigenous societies shaped the Americas before Columbus, why epidemic losses distorted later accounts, and what archaeology reveals about supposedly untouched landscapes.

item.title: The Dawn of Everything by David Graeber and David Wengrow
item.description: How ancient societies experimented with farming, cities, authority, and freedom—and why hierarchy was never a simple, inevitable price of civilization.

item.title: The Silk Roads by Peter Frankopan
item.description: How Eurasia's networks of trade, faith, conquest, and energy reshape the history of world power, from ancient Persia to the modern Middle East.
